project: On-site tilt-up concrete panel construction for the SD Group project
scope_of_works: Casting bed set-out, formwork, reinforcement, bond breaker application, insert and brace fixing, concrete pouring, curing and strength verification, pre-erection planning, crane mobilisation and lift preparation, panel erection by mobile crane, temporary bracing, permanent structural connections, ongoing brace monitoring, engineer-authorised brace removal, and final inspection/site clearance.
quick_scan_focus: temporary bracing and brace monitoring logic
crane / landing / exclusion zone interface logic
engineer hold points and brace-removal authority
concrete strength / curing prerequisites before lift
simultaneous operations and shared work-zone conflicts
